verified: Merchant decisions exactly match all 15 requested body mappings; 70 listed excluded articles never receive an add-on relation and are not deleted.
715 exact product/variant/SKU routes across 134 models and 44 bodies; 78 newly mapped merchant articles are usable. B010EXTGN remains held because exact HBCB010 is absent.
Generated route in theme is byte-identical to the independently generated data route. No prices are embedded in routing data.
Liquid checks exact parent variant+SKU and body variant+SKU, Hotbath vendor, quantity one, positive current price and no included-body metafield. Missing or changed identity fails closed.
No paid option is preselected. Body unavailable disables Yes; explicit No keeps original single-product cart notification behavior.
New product-form integration is nine added lines only. Existing cart-drawer/cart-notification/product-info/product-switcher files are unchanged.
Yes uses one batched POST with both exact variant IDs and parent quantity multiplied by one. Existing body lines in cart are not globally deduplicated.
No automatic retry or destructive rollback occurs after network/JSON/stock/partial-response uncertainty. The UI locks repeated addition and links to cart.
Success requires matching response IDs, SKUs and sufficient item quantities, then navigates to ordinary cart. The normal single-item notification protocol is not reused for the pair.
Double submit, stale parent identity, invalid quantities, not-ready custom element, disconnected element and already-running switcher navigation are blocked.
Existing mapped products are required to have exactly one variant. A future same-product AJAX variant change cannot submit a stale route because the input variant ID is rechecked.
Full-page product switcher choice restoration is one-use, short-lived, same-group and same-body only; it preserves explicit Yes or No and does not invent a selection.
Mapped dynamic checkout is removed, preventing direct product-page accelerated-checkout bypass. Unmapped products keep their original checkout control.
Both locale changes only add the bc namespace; all preexisting translation values are preserved.
Native fieldset, legend, labeled required radios, disabled stock states, focus handling and role-alert feedback provide accessible structure; visual/browser QA still needed.
No raw user-controlled HTML insertion, credential access, broad SKU-prefix mutation, guessed body ID or global cart mutation was introduced.
Final addon uses the localized explicit Ajax JSON endpoint {{ routes.cart_add_url }}.js; local-only theme-check found zero new errors and all 5 JS/CSS/JSON parser checks passed.

nonblocking_findings.finding: python3 -m unittest discover -s data -p test_runtime_mapping.py fails at setUpClass because FRESH_PATH is only declared inside __main__. The intended direct script entrypoint passes all 9 tests.
nonblocking_findings.minimal_fix: Define FRESH_PATH = ROOT / fresh-products.json at module scope; let __main__ optionally override it. Remove the redundant first cls.fresh_path assignment.
nonblocking_findings.production_impact: None; this affects alternate test invocation only.
